[ 44 ] MICT can also activate peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma co activator 1-alpha through the adenosine 5’-monophosphate-activated protein kinase (AMPK) dependent pathway, promoting mitochondrial DNA replication and respiratory chain complex synthesis, and enhancing oxidative phosphorylation ability.
